title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 211
paragraphs: When Tomyris learned what had happened to her army and her son, she sent a herald to Cyrus with this message: "Cyrus, insatiable for blood, do not be puffed up by what has happened. You conquered my son not in fair battle but by the fruit of the vine—the substance that fills you Persians until you lose your minds and say shameful things as it settles in your bellies. That is the weapon you used to overpower my son, not strength in combat. Now hear my good advice. Give me back my son and leave this land unpunished, even though you savaged a third of my army. If you refuse, I swear by the sun, the lord of the Massagetae, that for all your insatiable thirst, I will give you your fill of blood."
